ja543:1.1: Yaṃ kiñci ratanaṃ atthi Dhataraṭṭhassa nivesane sabbāni te upāyanti, dhītaraṃ dehi rājino ti.
ja543:2.1: Na no vivāho nāgehi katapubbo kudācanaṃ, taṃ vivāhaṃ asaṃyuttaṃ kathaṃ amhe karomase ti.
ja543:3.1: Jīvitaṃ nūna te cattaṃ raṭṭhaṃ vā manujādhipa, na hi nāge kupitamhi ciraṃ jīvanti tādisā.
ja543:4.1: Yo tvaṃ deva manusso 'si iddhimantaṃ aniddhimā Varuṇassa niyaṃ puttaṃ Yamunaṃ atimaññasīti.
ja543:5.1: Nātimaññāmi rājānaṃ Dhataraṭṭhaṃ yasassinaṃ, Dhataraṭṭho hi nāgānaṃ bahunnam api issaro.
ja543:6.1: Ahi mahānubhāvo pi na me dhītaram āraho, khattiyo ca Videhānaṃ, abhijātā Samuddajā ti.
ja543:7.1: Kambalassatarā uṭṭhentu, sabbe nāge nivedaya: Bārāṇasiṃ pavajjantu mā ca kiñci viheṭhayun ti.
ja543:8.1: Nivesanesu sobbhesu rathiyā caccaresu ca rukkhaggesu ca lambantu vitatā toraṇesu ca.
ja543:9.1: Aham pi sabbasetena mahatā sumahaṃ puraṃ parikkhipissaṃ bhogehi Kāsīnaṃ janayaṃ bhayan
ja543:10.1: ti. Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā uragā nekavaṇṇino Bārāṇasiṃ pavajjiṃsu na ca kañci viheṭhayuṃ.
ja543:11.1: Nivesanesu sobbhesu rathiyā caccaresu ca rukkhaggesu ca lambiṃsu vitatā toraṇesu ca.
ja543:12.1: Te su disvāna lambante puthu kandiṃsu nāriyo nāge soṇḍikate disvā passasante muhuṃ muhuṃ.
ja543:13.1: Bārāṇasī pavyadhitā āturā samapajjatha, bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ: dhītaraṃ dehi rājino ti.
ja543:15.1: Pupphābhihārassa vanassa majjhe ko lohitakkho vihatantaraṃso, kā kambukāyūradharā suvatthā tiṭṭhanti nariyo dasa vandamānā.
ja543:16.1: Ko tvaṃ brahābāhu vanassa majjhe virocasi ghaṭasitto va aggi, mahesakkho aññataro si yakkho, udāhu nāgo si mahānubhāvo ti.
ja543:17.1: Nāgo 'ham asmi iddhimā tejasī duratikkamo ḍaseyyaṃ tejasā kuddho phītaṃ janapadam api.
ja543:18.1: Samuddajā hi me mātā, Dhataraṭṭho ca me pitā, Sudassanakaniṭṭho 'smi, Bhūridatto ti maṃ vidū ti.
ja543:19.1: Yaṃ gambhīraṃ sadāvaṭṭaṃ rahadaṃ bhesmaṃ avekkhasi esa divyo mamāvāso anekasataporiso.
ja543:20.1: Mayūrakoñcābhirudaṃ nīlodaṃ vanamajjhato Yamunaṃ pavisa mābhīto khemaṃ vattavataṃ sivan
ja543:21.1: ti. Tattha patto sānucaro saha puttena brāhmaṇa pūjito mayhaṃ kāmehi sukhaṃ brāhmaṇa vacchasīti.
ja543:22.1: Samā samantā parito bahūtatagarā mahī indagopakasañchannā sobhati harituttamā.
ja543:23.1: Rammāni vanacetyāni rammā haṃsūpakūjitā opupphapadumā tiṭṭhanti pokkharaññā sunimmitā.
ja543:24.1: Aṭṭhaṃsā sukatā thambhā sabbe veluriyāmayā, sahassathambhā pāsādā pūrā kaññāhi jotare.
ja543:25.1: Vimānaṃ upapanno si dibbapuññehi attano asambādhaṃ sivaṃ rammaṃ accantasukhasaṃhitaṃ.
ja543:26.1: Maññe Sahassanettassa vimānaṃ nābhikaṃkhasi, iddhī hi t' āyaṃ vipulā Sakkass' eva jutīmato ti.
ja543:27.1: Manasāpi na pattabbo ānubhāvo jutīmato paricārayamānānaṃ saindānaṃ vasavattinan
ja543:28.1: ti. Taṃ vimāṇaṃ abhijjhāya amarānaṃ sukhesinaṃ uposathaṃ upavasanto semi vammikamuddhanīti.
ja543:29.1: Ahañ ca migam esāno saputto pāvisiṃ vanaṃ, taṃ maṃ mataṃ vā jīvaṃ vā nābhivedenti ñātakā.
ja543:30.1: Āmantaye Bhūridattaṃ Kāsiputtaṃ yasassinaṃ: tayā vo samanuññātā api passemu ñātake ti.
ja543:31.1: Eso hi vata me chando yaṃ va sesi mam' antike, na hi etādisā kāmā sulabhā honti mānuse.
ja543:32.1: Sace tvaṃ icchase vatthuṃ mama kāmehi pūjito mayā tvaṃ samanuññāto sotthiṃ passāhi ñātake ti
ja543:33.1: Dhāray' imaṃ maṇiṃ divyaṃ pasuṃ putte ca vindati arogo sukhito hoti, gacch' evādāya brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja543:34.1: Kusalaṃ paṭinandāmi Bhūridatta vaco tava, pabbajissāmi jiṇṇo 'smi, na kāme abhipatthaye ti.
ja543:35.1: Brahmacariyassa ce bhaṅgo hoti bhogehi kāriyaṃ, avikampamāno eyyāsi bahuṃ dassāmi te dhanan ti.
ja543:36.1: Kusalaṃ paṭinandāmi Bhūridatta vaco tava, puna pi āgamissāmi sace attho bhavissatīti.
ja543:37.1: Idaṃ vatvā Bhūridatto pesesi caturo jane: etha gacchatha uṭṭhetha khippaṃ pāpetha brāhmaṇaṃ.
ja543:38.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā uṭṭhāya caturo janā pesitā Bhūridattena khippaṃ pāpesuṃ brāhmaṇan ti.
ja543:40.1: Maṇiṃ paggayha maṅgalyaṃ sādhucittaṃ manoramaṃ selaṃ vyañjanasampannaṃ ko imaṃ maṇiṃ ajjhagā ti.
ja543:41.1: Lohitakkhasahassāhi samantā parivāritaṃ ajjakālaṃ padaṃ gacchaṃ ajjhagāhaṃ maṇiṃ iman ti.
ja543:42.1: Sūpaciṇṇo ayaṃ selo accito mahito sadā sudhārito sunikkhitto sabbattham abhisādhaye.
ja543:43.1: Upacāravipannassa nikkhepe dhāraṇāya vā ayaṃ selo vināsāya pariciṇṇo ayoniso.
ja543:44.1: Na imaṃ akusalo divyaṃ maṇiṃ dhāretum āraho, paṭipajja satan nikkhaṃ deh' imaṃ ratanaṃ maman
ja543:45.1: ti. Na vā m' āyaṃ maṇī keyyo gohi vā ratanena vā, selo vyañjanasampanno, n' eva keyyo maṇī maman
ja543:46.1: ti. No ce tayā maṇī keyyo gohi vā ratanena vā, atha kena maṇī keyyo, tam me akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja543:47.1: Yo me saṃse mahānāgaṃ tejasiṃ duratikkamaṃ tassa dajjaṃ imaṃ selaṃ jalanta-r-iva tejasā ti.
ja543:48.1: Ko nu brāhmaṇavaṇṇena supaṇṇo patataṃ varo nāgaṃ jigiṃsam anvesi anvesaṃ bhakkham attano ti.
ja543:49.1: Nāhaṃ dijādhipo homi, na diṭṭho garuḷo mayā, āsīvisena vitto ti vejjo maṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vidū ti.
ja543:50.1: Kin nu tuyhaṃ balaṃ atthi, kiṃ sippaṃ vijjate tava, kismiṃ vā tvaṃ paratthaddho uragaṃ nāpacāyasīti.
ja543:51.1: Araññakassa isino cirarattatapassino supaṇṇo Kosiyass' akkhā visavijjaṃ anuttaraṃ.
ja543:52.1: Taṃ bhāvitatt' aññataraṃ sammantaṃ pabbatantare sakkaccaṃ taṃ upaṭṭhāsi rattindivam atandito.
ja543:53.1: So tadā pariciṇṇo me vatavā brahmacariyavā dibbaṃ pātukarī mantaṃ kāmasā bhagavā mamaṃ.
ja543:54.1: -āhaṃ mante paratthaddho, nāhaṃ bhāyāmi bhoginaṃ, ācariyo visaghātānaṃ Ālambāno ti maṃ vidū ti.
ja543:55.1: Gaṇhāmase maṇiṃ tāta, Somadatta vijānahi, mā daṇḍena siriṃ pattaṃ kāmasā pajahimhase ti.
ja543:56.1: Sakaṃ nivesanaṃ pattaṃ yo taṃ brāhmaṇa pūjayi evaṃkalyāṇakārissa kiṃ mohā dūbhim icchasi.
ja543:57.1: Sace hi dhanakāmo si Bhūridatto padassati, tam eva gantvā yācassu bahuṃ dassati te dhanan ti.
ja543:58.1: Hatthagataṃ pattagataṃ nikkiṇṇaṃ khādituṃ varaṃ, mā no sandiṭṭhiko attho Somadatta upaccagā ti.
ja543:59.1: Paccati Niraye ghore mahissam avadīyati mittadūbhī hitaccāgī jīvare cāpi sussare.
ja543:60.1: Sace hi dhanakāmo si Bhūridatto padassati, maññe attakataṃ veraṃ naciraṃ vedayissasīti.
ja543:61.1: Mahāyaññaṃ yajitvāna evaṃ sujjhanti brāhmaṇā, mahāyaññaṃ yajissāma, evaṃ mokkhāma pāpakā ti.
ja543:62.1: Handa dāni apāyāmi nāhaṃ ajja tayā saha padam p' ekaṃ na gaccheyyaṃ evaṃkibbisakārinā
ja543:63.1: ti. Idaṃ vatvāna pitaraṃ Somadatto bahussuto ujjhāpetvāna bhūtāni tamhā ṭhānā apakkamīti.
ja543:64.1: Gaṇhāh' etaṃ mahānāgaṃ āhar' etaṃ maṇiṃ mama indagopakavaṇṇābhā yassa lohitako siro.
ja543:65.1: Kappāsapicurāsīva eso kāy' assa dissati, vammikaggagato seti, taṃ tvaṃ gaṇhāhi brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja543:66.1: Ath' osadhehi dibbehi japaṃ mantapadāni ca evan taṃ asakkhi saṭṭhuṃ katvā parittam attano ti.
ja543:68.1: Mamaṃ disvāna āyantaṃ sabbakāmasamiddhinaṃ indriyāni ahaṭṭhāni sāmaṃ jātaṃ mukhan tava,
ja543:69.1: Padumaṃ yathā hatthagataṃ pāṇinā parimadditaṃ sāmaṃ jātaṃ mukhaṃ tuyhaṃ mamaṃ disvāna edisan ti.
ja543:70.1: Kaccin nu te nābhisasi, kacci te n' atthi vedanā, yan te sāmaṃ mukhaṃ tuyhaṃ mamaṃ disvāna āgatan ti.
ja543:71.1: Supinan tāta addakkhiṃ ito māsaṃ adhogataṃ: dakkhiṇaṃ viya me bāhaṃ chetvā ruhiramakkhitaṃ puriso ādāya pakkāmi mamaṃ rodantiyā sati.
ja543:72.1: Yato supinam addakkhiṃ Sudassana vijānahi tato divā vā rattiṃ vā sukham me nopalabbhatīti.
ja543:73.1: Yaṃ pubbe paricāriṃsu kaññā ruciraviggahā hemajālapaṭicchannā Bhūridatto na dissati.
ja543:74.1: Yaṃ pubbe paricāriṃsu nettiṃsavaradhārino kaṇikārā va samphullā Bhūridatto na dissati.
ja543:75.1: Handa dāni gamissāmi Bhūridattanivesanaṃ, dhammaṭṭhaṃ sīlasampannaṃ passāma tava bhātaran ti.
ja543:76.1: Tañ ca disvāna āyantiṃ Bhūridattassa mātaraṃ bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ Bhūridattassa nāriyo.
ja543:77.1: Puttaṃ t' ayye na jānāma ito māsaṃ adhogataṃ mataṃ vā yadivā jīvaṃ Bhūridattaṃ yasassinan ti.
ja543:78.1: Sakuṇī hataputtā va suññaṃ disvā kulāvakaṃ ciraṃ dukkhena jhāyissaṃ Bhūridattaṃ apassatī.
ja543:80.1: Sā nūna cakkavākīva pallalasmiṃ anūdake ciraṃ dukkhena jhāyissaṃ Bhūridattaṃ apassatī.
ja543:81.1: Kammārānaṃ yathā ukkā anto jhāyati no bahi evaṃ jhāyāmi sokena Bhūridattaṃ appassatī.
ja543:82.1: Sālā va sampamathitā mālutena pamadditā senti puttā ca dārā ca Bhūridattanivesane
ja543:83.1: ti. Idaṃ sutvāna nigghosaṃ Bhūridattanivesane Ariṭṭho ca Subhago ca upadhāviṃsu anantarā.
ja543:84.1: Amma assāsa mā soci, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino cavanti upapajjanti, es' assa pariṇāmitā ti.
ja543:85.1: Aham pi tāta jānāmi: evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino, Sokena ca paret' asmi Bhūridattaṃ apassatī.
ja543:86.1: Ajja ce me imaṃ rattiṃ -- Sudassana vijānahi -- Bhūridattaṃ apassantī maññe hessāmi jīvitan ti.
ja543:87.1: Amma assāsa mā soci, ānayissāma bhātaraṃ, disodisaṃ gamissāma bhātu pariyesanañ caraṃ
ja543:88.1: Pabbate giriduggesu gāmesu nigamesu ca, orena dasarattassa bhātaraṃ passa āgatan ti.
ja543:89.1: Hatthā pamutto urago pāde te nipatī bhusaṃ, kacci t' ānuḍasī tāta, mā bhāyi sukhito bhavā 'ti.
ja543:90.1: N' eva mayhaṃ ayaṃ nāgo alan dukkhāya kāyaci, yāvat' atthi ahiggāho mayā bhiyyo na vijjatīti.
ja543:91.1: Ko nu brāhmaṇavaṇṇena datto parisam āgamā avhayantu suyuddhena, suṇātu parisā maman
ja543:92.1: ti. Tvaṃ maṃ nāgena ālamba ahaṃ maṇḍūkachāpiyā, hotu no abbhutaṃ tattha ā. sahassehi pañcahīti.
ja543:93.1: Ahaṃ hi vasumā aḍḍho, tvaṃ daliddo si māṇava, ko nu te pāṭibhog' atthi, upajūtañ ca kiṃ siyā.
ja543:94.1: Upajūtañ ca me assa pāṭibhogo ca tādiso, assa no abbhutaṃ tattha ā. sahassehi pañcahīti.
ja543:95.1: Suṇohi me mahārāja vacanaṃ, bhaddam atthu te, pañcannaṃ me sahassānaṃ pāṭibhogo hi kittimā ti.
ja543:96.1: Pettikaṃ vā iṇaṃ hoti yaṃ vā hoti sayaṃkataṃ, kiṃ tvaṃ evaṃ bahuṃ mayhaṃ dhanaṃ yācasi brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja543:97.1: Ālambāno hi nāgena mamaṃ abhijigiṃsati, ahaṃ maṇḍūkachāpiyā ḍaṃsayissāmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
ja543:98.1: Taṃ tvaṃ daṭṭhuṃ mahārāja ajja raṭṭhābhivaḍḍhana khattasaṃghaparibbūḷho niyyāhi abhidassanan ti.
ja543:99.1: N' eva taṃ atimaññāmi sippavādena māṇava, atimatt' āsi sippena, uragaṃ nāpacāyasīti.
ja543:100.1: Mayam pi nātimaññāma sippavādena brāhmaṇaṃ, avisena ca nāgena bhusaṃ vañcayase janaṃ.
ja543:101.1: Evaṃ ce taṃ jano jaññā yathā jānāmi taṃ ahaṃ na tvaṃ labhasi Ālamba sattumuṭṭhiṃ kuto dhanan ti.
ja543:102.1: Kharājino jaṭī rummī datto parisam āgato, so tvaṃ evaṃgataṃ nāgaṃ ‘aviso' atimaññasi.
ja543:103.1: Āsajja kho naṃ jaññāsi puṇṇaṃ uggassa tejasā, maññe taṃ bhasmarāsiṃ va khippaṃ eso karissatīti.
ja543:104.1: Siyā visaṃ siluttassa deḍḍubhassa silābhuno n' eva lohitasīsassa visaṃ nāgassa vijjatīti.
ja543:105.1: Sutaṃ me taṃ arahataṃ saññatānaṃ tapassinaṃ: idha dānāni datvāna saggaṃ gacchanti dāyakā, jīvanto dehi dānāni yadi te atthi dātave.
ja543:106.1: Ayaṃ nāgo mahiddhiko tejasī duratikkamo, tena taṃ ḍaṃsayissāmi, so taṃ bhasmaṃ karissati.
ja543:107.1: Mayāp' etaṃ sutaṃ samma saññatānaṃ tapassinaṃ: idha dānāni datvāna saggaṃ gacchanti dāyakā, tvam eva dehi jīvanto yadi te atthi dātave.
ja543:108.1: Ayaṃ Accimukhī nāma puṇṇā uggassa tejasā, tāya taṃ ḍaṃsayissāmi, sā taṃ bhasmaṃ karissati.
ja543:109.1: Yā dhītā Dhataraṭṭhassa vemātābhaginī mama sā dissatu Accīmukhī puṇṇī uggassa tejasā ti.
ja543:110.1: Chamāyaṃ ce nisiñcissaṃ -- Brahmadatta vijānahi -- tiṇalatāni osajjho ussusseyyuṃ asaṃsayan ti.
ja543:111.1: Uddhañ ce pātayissāmi -- Brahmadatta vijānahi -- sattavassān' ayaṃ devo na vasse na himaṃ pate ti.
ja543:112.1: Udakañ ce nisiñcissaṃ -- Brahmadatta vijānahi -- yāvatā udakajā pāṇā mareyyuṃ macchakacchapā ti.
ja543:114.1: Lokyaṃ sajantaṃ udakaṃ Payāgasmim patiṭṭhitaṃ ko maṃ ajjhoharī bhūto ogāḷhaṃ Yamunaṃ nadin ti.
ja543:115.1: Ya-d-esa lokādhipatī yasassī Bārāṇasiṃ pakiraparī samantato tassāhaṃ putto uragūsabhassa, Subhago ti maṃ brāhmaṇa vedayantīti.
ja543:116.1: Sace hi putto uragūsabhassa Kaṃsassa rañño amarādhipassa mahesakkho aññataro pitā te maccesu mātā pana te atulyā na tādiso arahati brāhmaṇassa dāsam pi ohātuṃ mahānubhāvo ti.
ja543:117.1: Rukkhaṃ nissāya vijjhittho eṇeyyaṃ pātum āgataṃ, so viddho dūram asarā saravegena sekhavā.
ja543:118.1: Taṃ tvaṃ patitam addakkhi araññasmiṃ brahāvane sa maṃsakācam ādāya sāyaṃ nigrodh' upāgami
ja543:119.1: Suvasāliyasaṃghuṭṭhaṃ piṅgiyaṃ santhatāyutaṃ kokilābhirudaṃ rammaṃ dhuvaṃ haritasaddalaṃ.
ja543:120.1: Tattha te so pāturahu iddhiyā yasasā jalaṃ mahānubhāvo bhātā me kaññāhi parivārito.
ja543:121.1: So tena pariciṇṇo tvaṃ sabbakāmehi tappito adūbhassa tuvaṃ dūbhi, tan te veraṃ idhāgataṃ.
ja543:122.1: Khippaṃ gīvaṃ pasārehi, na te dassāmi jīvitaṃ, bhātu parisaraṃ veraṃ chedayissāmi te siran ti.
ja543:123.1: Ajjhāyako yācayogo āhutaggi ca brāhmaṇo, etehi tīhi ṭhānehi avajjho bhavati brāhmaṇo ti.
ja543:124.1: Yaṃ puraṃ Dhataraṭṭhassa ogāḷhaṃ Yamunaṃ nadiṃ jotate sabbasovaṇṇaṃ girim āhacca Yāmunaṃ.
ja543:125.1: Tattha te purisavyagghā sodariyā mama bhātaro, yathā te tattha vakkhanti tathā hessasi brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja543:127.1: Anittarā ittarasampayuttā yaññā ca vedā ca subhoga loke, tad aggarayhaṃ hi vinindamāno jahāti vittañ ca satañ ca dhamman ti.
ja543:128.1: Ajjhenam ariyā paṭhaviṃ janindā vessā kasiṃ pāricariyañ ca suddā upāgu paccekaṃ yathā padesaṃ katāhu ete Vasinā ti āhū ti.
ja543:129.1: Dhātā Vidhātā Varuṇo Kuvero Somo Yamo Candimā y' āpi Suriyo ete hi yaññaṃ puthuso yajitvā ajjhāyakānaṃ atha sabbakāme.
ja543:130.1: Vikāsitā cāpasatāni pañca yo Ajjuno balavā bhīmaseno sahassabāhu asamo pathavyā so pi tadā ādahi jātavedan ti.
ja543:131.1: Yo brāhmaṇe bhojayi dīgharattaṃ annena pānena yathānubhāvaṃ pasannacitto anumodamāno subhoga devaññataro ahosīti.
ja543:132.1: Mahāsanaṃ devam anomavaṇṇam yo sappinā asakkhi jetum Aggiṃ so yaññatan taṃ varato yajitvā dibbaṃ gatiṃ Mujalind' ajjhagañchīti.
ja543:133.1: Mahānubhāvo vassasahassajīvī yo pabbaji dassaneyyo uḷāro hitvā apariyantarathaṃ sasenaṃ rājā Dujīpo pi jagāma saggan ti.
ja543:134.1: Yo sāgarantaṃ Sāgaro vijitvā yūpaṃ subhaṃ soṇṇamayaṃ uḷāraṃ ussesi Vessānaram ādahāno subhoga devaññataro ahosi.
ja543:135.1: Yassānubhāvena subhoga Gaṅgā pavattatha dadhisannam samuddaṃ sa lomapādo paricariya-m-aggiṃ Aṅgo sahassakkhapur' ajjhagañchīti.
ja543:136.1: Mahiddhiko devavaro yasassī senāpatī tidive Vāsavassa sa somayāgena malaṃ vihantvā subhoga devaññataro ahosīti.
ja543:137.1: Akāri yo lokam imaṃ parañ ca Bhāgīrasiṃ Himavantañ ca Gijjhaṃ yo iddhimā devavaro yasassī so pi tadā ādahi jātavedaṃ.
ja543:138.1: Mālāgirī Himavā yo ca Gijjho Sudassano Nisabho Kākaneru ete ca aññe ca nagā mahantā cityā katā yaññakarehi-m-āhū ti.
ja543:139.1: Ajjhāyakaṃ mantaguṇūpapannaṃ tapassinaṃ yācayogo ti cāha, tīre samuddass' udakaṃ sajantaṃ taṃ sāgar' ajjhohari, ten' apeyyo ti.
ja543:140.1: Āyāgavatthūni puthū pathavyā saṃvijjanti brāhmaṇā Vāsavassa, purimaṃ disaṃ pacchimaṃ dakkhiṇuttaraṃ saṃvijjamānā janayanti vedan ti.
ja543:141.1: Kalī hi dhīrānaṃ kaṭaṃ magānaṃ bhavanti vedajjhagatān' Ariṭṭha marīcidhammaṃ asamekkhitattā, māyāguṇā nātivahanti paññaṃ.
ja543:142.1: Vedā na tāṇāya bhavanti-r-assa mittadduno bhūnahuno narassa, na tāyate pariciṇṇo ca aggi dosantaraṃ maccaṃ anariyakammaṃ.
ja543:143.1: Sabbañ ca maccā sadhanā sabhogā ādīpitaṃ dāru tiṇena missaṃ dahan na tappe asamatthatejo, ko taṃ subhikkhaṃ dirasaññu kuriyā.
ja543:144.1: Yathāpi khīraṃ viparināmadhammaṃ dadhi bhavitvā navanītam pi hoti evam pi aggi viparināmadhammo tejo samorohatī yogayutto.
ja543:145.1: Na dissate aggi-m-anuppaviṭṭho sukkhesu kaṭṭhesu navesu cāpi, nāmanthamāno araṇīnarena nākammanā jāyati jātavedo.
ja543:146.1: Sace hi aggi antarato vaseyya sukkhesu kaṭṭhesu navesu cāpi sabbāni susseyyuṃ vanāni loke sukkhāni kaṭṭhāni ca pajjaleyyuṃ.
ja543:147.1: Karoti ce dārutiṇena puññaṃ bhojaṃ naro dhūmasikhiṃ patāpavaṃ aṅgārikā loṇakarā ca sūdā sarīradāhāpi kareyyuṃ puññaṃ.
ja543:148.1: Atha ce hi ete na karonti puññaṃ ajjhenamaggiṃ idha tappayitvā na koci lokasmiṃ karoti puññaṃ bhojaṃ naro dhūmasikhiṃ patāpavaṃ.
ja543:149.1: Kathaṃ hi lokāpacito samāno amanuññagandhaṃ bahunnaṃ akantaṃ yad eva maccā parivajjayanti tad appasatthaṃ dirasaññu bhuñje.
ja543:150.1: Sikhiṃ hi devesu vadanti h' eke, āpaṃ milakkhā pana devam āhu, sabbe va ete vitathaṃ bhaṇanti, aggī na devaññataro na cāpo.
ja543:151.1: Nirindriyaṃ santaṃ asaññakāyaṃ vessānaraṃ kammakaraṃ pajānaṃ paricariya-m-aggiṃ sugatiṃ kathaṃ vaje pāpāni kammāni pakubbamāno.
ja543:152.1: Sabbābhibhū t' āhu 'dha jīvikatthā aggissa Brahmā paricāriko ti, sabbānubhāvī ca vasī kimatthaṃ animmito nimmitaṃ vandit' assa.
ja543:153.1: Hassaṃ anijjhānakhamaṃ atacchaṃ sakkārahetu pakiriṃsu pubbe, te lābhasakkāre apātubhonte santhambhitā jantuhi santidhammaṃ.
ja543:154.1: Ajjhenam ariyā paṭhaviṃ janindā vessā kasiṃ pāricariyañ ca suddā upāgu paccekaṃ yathā padesaṃ, katāhu ete Vasinā ti āhu.
ja543:155.1: Etañ ca saccaṃ vacanaṃ bhaveyya yathā idaṃ bhāsitaṃ brāhmaṇehi nākhattiyo jātu labhetha rajjaṃ nābrāhmaṇo mantapadāni sikkhe nāññatra vessehi kasiṃ kareyya suddo na muñce parapessitāya.
ja543:156.1: Yasmā ca etaṃ vacanaṃ abhūtaṃ musā c' ime odariyā bhaṇanti tad appapaññā abhisaddahanti passanti taṃ paṇḍitā attanā va.
ja543:157.1: Khattā na vessā na baliṃ haranti, ādāya satthāni caranti brāhmaṇā, tan tādisaṃ saṃkhubhitaṃ vibhinnaṃ kasmā Brahmā n' ujjukaroti lokaṃ.
ja543:158.1: Sace hi so issaro sabbaloke Brahmā bahūbhūtapatī pajānaṃ kiṃ sabbaloke vidahī alakkhiṃ kiṃ sabbalokaṃ na sukhiṃ akāsi.
ja543:159.1: Sace hi so issaro sabbaloke Brahmā bahūbhūtapatī pajānaṃ māyāmusāvajjamadena cāpi lokaṃ adhammena kimatth' akāsi.
ja543:160.1: Sace hi so issaro sabbaloke Brahmā bahūbhūtapatī pajānaṃ adhammiyo bhūtapatī Ariṭṭha dhamme satī yo vidahī adhammaṃ.
ja543:161.1: Kīṭā paṭaṅgā uragā ca bhekā hantvā kimiṃ sujjhati makkhikā ca, ete hi dhammā anariyarūpā Kambojakānaṃ vitathā bahunnan ti.
ja543:162.1: Sace hi so sujjhati yo hanāti hato pi so saggam upeti ṭhānaṃ bhovādi bhovādina mārayeyyuṃ ye cāpi tesaṃ abhisaddaheyyuṃ.
ja543:163.1: N' evā migā na-ppasu no pi gāvo āyācanti attavadhāya keci vipphandamānā idha jīvikatthā, yaññesu pāṇe pasum āharanti.
ja543:164.1: Yūpassa ne pasubandhe ca bālā cittehi vaṇṇehi mukhan nayanti: ayan te yūpo kāmaduho parattha bhavissati sassato samparāye.
ja543:165.1: Sace ca yūpe maṇisaṃkhamuttaṃ dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ sukkhesu kaṭṭhesu navesu cāpi sace duhe tidive sabbakāme tevijjasaṃghā ca puthū yajeyyuṃ na brāhmaṇaṃ kañci taṃ yājayeyyuṃ.
ja543:166.1: Kuto ca yūpe maṇisaṃkhamuttaṃ dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ sukkhesu kaṭṭhesu navesu cāpi, kuto duhe tidive sabbakāme.
ja543:167.1: Saṭhā ca luddā upaladdhabālā cittehi vaṇṇehi mukhan nayanti: ādāya aggiṃ mama dehi vittaṃ tato sukhī hohisi sabbakāme.
ja543:168.1: Tam aggihuttaṃ saraṇaṃ pavissa {cittehi} vaṇṇehi mukhan nayanti, oropayitvā kesamassuṃ nakhañ ca vedehi vittaṃ atigāḷayanti.
ja543:169.1: Kākā ulūkaṃ va raho labhitvā ekaṃ samānaṃ bahukā samecca annāni bhutvā kuhakā kuhitvā muṇḍaṃ katvā yaññapath' ossajanti.
ja543:170.1: Evaṃ hi so vañcito brāhmaṇehi eko samāno, bahukā samecca te yogayogena vilumpamānā diṭṭhaṃ adiṭṭhena dhanaṃ haranti.
ja543:171.1: Akāsiyā rājuhi vānusiṭṭhā tad assa ādāya dhanaṃ haranti, te tādisā corasamā asantā vajjhā na haññanti Ariṭṭha loke.
ja543:172.1: Indassa bāhā-r-asi dakkhiṇā ti yaññesu chindanti palāsayaṭṭhiṃ, taṃ ce pi saccaṃ Maghavā chinnabāhu ken' assa Indo asure jināti.
ja543:173.1: Tañ c' eva tucchaṃ, Maghavā samaṅgī hantā avajjho paramo sa devo, mantā ime brāhmaṇā tuccharūpā sandiṭṭhiyā vañcanā esa loke.
ja543:174.1: Mālāgiri Himavā yo ca Gijjho (= p. 204,13) Sudassano Nisabho Kākaneru ete ca aññe ca nagā mahantā cityā katā yaññakarehi-m-āhu.
ja543:175.1: Yathappakārāni hi iṭṭhakāni cityā katā yaññakarehi-m-āhu na pabbatā honti tathappakārā aññādisā acalā tiṭṭhaselā.
ja543:176.1: Na iṭṭhakā honti silā cirena pi, na tattha sañjāyati ayo na lohaṃ, yaññañ ca etaṃ parivaṇṇayantā cityā katā yaññakarehi-m-āhu.
ja543:177.1: Ajjhāyakaṃ mantaguṇūpapannaṃ tapassinaṃ yācayogo ti-m-āhu, tīre samuddass' udakaṃ sajantaṃ taṃ sāgar' ajjhohari ten' apeyyo.
ja543:178.1: Parosahassam pi samantavede mantūpapanne nadiyo vahanti, na tena vyāpannarasūdakā naṃ, kasmā samuddo atulo apeyyo.
ja543:179.1: Ye keci kūpā idha jīvaloke loṇūdakā kūpakhaṇehi khātā na brāhmaṇajjhoharanena tesu āpo apeyyo dirasaññu-r-āhu.
ja543:180.1: Pure puratthā kā kassa bhariyā, mano manussam ajanesi pubbe, tenāpi dhammena na koci hīno, evam pi vossaggavibhaṅgam āhu.
ja543:181.1: Caṇḍālaputto pi adhicca vede bhāseyya mante kusalo mutīmā, na tassa muddhāpi phaleyya sattadhā, mantā ime attavadhāya kattā.
ja543:182.1: Vācā katā giddhikatā gahītā dummocayā kavyāpathānupannā, bālāna cittaṃ visame niviṭṭhaṃ tad appapaññā abhisaddahanti.
ja543:183.1: Sīhassa vyagghassa ca dīpino ca na vijjatī porisiyaṃ balena, manussabhāvo ca gavaṃ va pekkho jāti hi tesaṃ asamā samānā.
ja543:184.1: Sace ca rājā paṭhaviṃ vijitvā sajīvavā assavo pārisajjo sayam eva so sattusaṃghaṃ vijeyya tassa pajā niccasukhā bhaveyya.
ja543:185.1: Khattiyamantā ca tayo ca vedā atthena ete samakā bhavanti, tesañ ca atthaṃ avinicchinitvā na bujjhatī oghapathaṃ va channaṃ.
ja543:186.1: Khattiyamantā ca tayo ca vedā atthena ete samakā bhavanti, lābho alābho ayaso yaso ca sabbe te sabbesaṃ catunna dhammā.
ja543:187.1: Yathāpi ibbhā dhanadhaññahetu kammāni kārenti puthū pathavyā tevijjasaṃghāpi tath' eva ajja kammāni kārenti puthū pathavyā.
ja543:188.1: Ibbhā hi ete samakā bhavanti, niccossukā kāmaguṇesu yuttā kammāni kārenti puthū pathavyā, tad appapaññā dirasaññu ārā ti.
ja543:190.1: Kassa bherī mutiṅgā ca saṃkhā paṇavadeṇḍimā (V 322|4) purato paṭipannāni hāsayantā rathesabhaṃ.
ja543:191.1: Kassa kañcanapaṭṭena puthunā vijjuvaṇṇinā yuvā kalāpasannaddho, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja543:192.1: Ukkāmukhe pahaṭṭhaṃ va khadiraṅgārasannibhaṃ mukhaṃ cāru-r-ivābhāti, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja543:193.1: Kassa jambonadaṃ chattaṃ sasalākaṃ manoramaṃ ādiccaraṃsāvaraṇaṃ, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja543:194.1: Kassa aṃkaṃ pariggayha vālavījanim uttamaṃ carate varapaññassa muddhani uparūpari.
ja543:195.1: Kassa pekhuṇahatthāni vicitrāni mudūni ca tapaññamaṇidaṇḍāni caranti ubhatomukhaṃ.
ja543:196.1: Khadiraṅgāravaṇṇābhā ukkāmukhapahaṃsitā kass' ete kuṇḍalā vaggū sobhanti ubhatomukhaṃ.
ja543:197.1: Kassa vātena chupitā niddhantā mudukāḷakā sobhayanti nalāṭantaṃ nabhā vijju-r-iv' uggatā.
ja543:198.1: Kassa etāni akkhīni āyatāni puthūni ca, ko sobhati visālakkho, kass' etaṃ uṇṇajaṃ mukhaṃ.
ja543:199.1: Kassa te lapanajā suddhā suddhasaṃkhavarūpamā bhāsamānassa sobhanti dantā kuppilasādisā.
ja543:200.1: Kassa lākhārasasamā hatthapādā sukhe ṭhitā, ko so bimboṭṭhasampanno divā suriyo va bhāsati.
ja543:201.1: Himaccaye hemavato brahāsālo va pupphito ko so odātapāvāro jayaṃ Indo va sobhati.
ja543:202.1: Suvaṇṇapilakākiṇṇaṃ maṇidaṇḍavicittitaṃ ko so parisam ogayha īso khaggaṃ va muñcati
ja543:203.1: Suvaṇṇacitakā citrā sukatā citrasibbanā ko so omuñcate pādā namo katvā mahesino ti.
ja543:204.1: Dhātaraṭṭhā hi te nāgā iddhimanto yasassino Samuddajāya uppannā nāgā ete mahiddhikā ti.
